message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years (including the franchise’s earlier incarnations as the Buffalo Braves and San Diego Clippers):

| Era | Notable Players | Notes |
|-----|-----------------|-------|
| **1970s‑80s (Buffalo/San Diego)** | *Bob McAdoo*, *Kermit Washington*, *Bill Walton* | Early stars before the move to LA. |
| **1990s** | *Danny Manning*, *Moses Malone*, *Julius Erving* (short stint) | The team struggled but had some big names. |
| **2000s** | *Chris Webber*, *Penny Hardaway*, *Derek Fisher* | A mix of veteran talent and young prospects. |
| **2010s (LA era)** | *Chris Paul*, *Blake Griffin*, *DeAndre Jordan*, *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Julius Randle*, *Reggie Jackson* | The Clippers’ “Lob City” era and playoff pushes. |
| **2020s (current roster)** | *Paul George*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Julius Randle*, *Kawhi Leonard* (until 2023), *Jamal Murray*, *Bam Adebayo*, *Rudy Gobert* (trade), *Jalen Green*, *Coby White*, *Jabari Smith Jr.* | The team has been building a contender with a mix of veterans and young talent. |

> **Quick facts:**  
> • The franchise began as the Buffalo Braves (1967‑1978).  
> • Moved to San Diego (1978‑1984) as the San Diego Clippers.  
> • Relocated to Los Angeles in 1984 and became the Los Angeles Clippers.  

If you’re looking for a specific decade or a deeper dive into player stats, let me know!
